subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should Telegram allow multiple independent ACP bindings for one bot account and one topic, or should same-account binds remain a single active handoff?
rationale: The current docs and runtime model resolve one current thread binding for a conversation, while this PR describes independent same-topic sessions but implements replacement semantics.

options.title: Keep One Active Topic Binding
options.body: Rework this PR as a same-account handoff plus cross-account fence while preserving plugin-state storage and migration exports.

options.title: Design Real Multi-Binding Routing
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers define how inbound topic messages choose among multiple same-account ACP sessions.

options.title: Close As Not Planned
options.body: Close this PR if same-topic multi-agent binding is outside the intended Telegram product model.

recommendation.title: Keep One Active Topic Binding
recommendation.body: Rework this PR as a same-account handoff plus cross-account fence while preserving plugin-state storage and migration exports.

likelyOwner.reason: The current storage and migration contract are blame-tied to recent work by vincentkoc, and the decision affects that same Telegram runtime boundary.
